Title: Presidency Credits Tinubu’s Economic Reforms For Strong H1 2026 Corporate Earnings
Summary: Presidency says Tinubu's reforms drive stronger corporate earnings, improved investor confidence and robust first-half performance across major listed firms.

Title: Kwara State Confirns 176 Abducted Women, Children Regain Freedom After Six Months In Captivity
Summary: Kwara State confirms release of 176 Woro and Nuku kidnap victims after six months, thanking security forces and Federal Government.

Summary: Accord party alleges EFCC targets Osun government before governorship poll and urges Tinubu to guarantee a free, credible election process.

Summary: Akume says Tinubu welcomes Catholic Bishops’ counsel while rejecting one-party state claims and reaffirming commitment to democratic governance nationwide.

Summary: EFCC says it froze Osun State's accounts after detecting suspicious transfers during an ongoing investigation into alleged N11 billion fraud.

Title: Tinubu Celebrates NEDC Chairman Paul Tarfa At 85, Hails Lifetime Of National Service
Summary: President Tinubu celebrates NEDC Chairman Paul Tarfa's 85th birthday, praising his patriotism, leadership and contributions to national development.

Summary: Nasarawa Governor Sule directs local government chairmen to replicate women-focused peacebuilding training across Nasarawa's 13 councils to strengthen communities.

Summary: ADC condemns suspension of Osun local government allocations, alleging political intimidation and urging immediate restoration of statutory funds.

Summary: Crime correspondents call on Nigerians to submit policy proposals to help shape state policing and strengthen the country's security framework.

Summary: Defence Minister Musa urges troops to justify new salary increase by intensifying operations against insurgency, banditry, kidnapping and oil theft.

Title: CSO Coalition Backs DSS DG Ajayi, Endorses Tinubu’s Governance Agenda
Summary: Civil society coalition endorses President Tinubu and DSS Director-General Oluwatosin Ajayi, citing reforms, professionalism and improved national security efforts.

Summary: Nasarawa Governor Abdullahi Sule appoints eight commissioner-nominees as part of efforts to strengthen his administration before leaving office.

Title: Mexican TikTok Influencer Shot Dead While Livestreaming
Summary: Mexican TikTok influencer César Gastélum was shot dead while livestreaming as gunmen attacked outside a fast-food restaurant in Mexico.

Summary: Luís Figo has urged Gianni Infantino to resign, as UEFA and football associations intensify opposition to FIFA’s failed investment plan.

Title: Union Warns Against Rushing Robotaxi Rollout In London Over Safety, Job Loss Fears
Summary: GMB urges caution after TfL approves Uber robotaxis for London, warning of job losses, safety concerns and risks to passengers.

Title: Kwara: Kaiama Abductees Regain Freedom After Six Months In Captivity
Summary: Kaiama abductees regain freedom after six months in captivity, as Kwara government commends security forces and President Tinubu's support.

Title: Radda Approves N4bn For Community Projects, Smart School ICT Infrastructure In Katsina
Summary: katsina state Governor Radda approves N4 billion for ward projects and smart school ICT infrastructure to boost grassroots development and education.

Title: Ailing Filmmaker Ola Balogun Donates Kidneys, Eyes, Other Organs In Public Will
Summary: Veteran filmmaker Ola Balogun directs that his organs and body be donated for transplants, medical research and doctors' training.

Title: British Boxer Raven Chapman Recovering After Emergency Surgery Following Brain Bleed
Summary: British boxer Raven Chapman is recovering after emergency brain surgery following a training collapse in Denmark, with rehabilitation planned in the UK.

Title: Infantino Convenes Emergency FIFA Talks In Morocco As Leadership Pressure Mounts
Summary: FIFA President Gianni Infantino convenes emergency talks in Morocco as mounting opposition threatens his leadership ahead of next year’s election.
